title: ODNI nine-month operation against whistleblowers and journalists

tellings.quote: I just want you to know that ODNI ran an operation for 9 months.

plain: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the US office that oversees all the spy agencies, is said to have run a nine-month operation aimed at UFO whistleblowers and journalists around 2025 and 2026. Jeremy Corbell, who reports on UFOs and tells it as something he knows first-hand, says flatly to Michels, "ODNI ran an operation for 9 months." He ties it to the journalist George Knapp, the whistleblowers Dylan Borland and Matthew Brown, the intelligence chief Tulsi Gabbard and a group he calls the Directors Initiative Group, and tells it as proof that the government watched the people pushing for UFO disclosure.
